messages:
Nina: heads up — fresh SDK install + sample app hits mypy/pyright errors from autogenerated pyi for async client.
Omar: paste minimal repro?
Nina: snippet:
```py
from typing import Optional, Dict
from pydantic import BaseModel

class Payload(BaseModel):
    name: str
    meta: Optional[Dict[str, str]] = None

async def run(client):
    async for p in client.payloads():
        # mypy errors: Item \"None\" of \"Optional[Dict[str, str]]\" has no attribute \"items\"
        for k, v in p.meta.items():
            pass
```
kevin-ci: mypy output is the usual:
```
main.py:11: error: Item \"None\" of \"Optional[Dict[str, str]]\" has no attribute \"items\"  [attr-defined]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 1 source file)
```
Omar: sounds like a stub/runtime mismatch. Are the .pyi fields marked Optional? Also some streams sometimes yield None as heartbeat wrappers.
Nina: pyi typesize shows AsyncIterator[Payload] (not Optional) and the Payload.meta field in the pyi is not Optional even though model default is None.
kevin-ci: short-term: add defensive guard `if p.meta:` or `assert p.meta is not None`. Long-term: change autogen to emit Optional[...] for fields with default None and mark streaming APIs Optional when they can be absent.
Omar: also add a small mypy/pyright integration test in autogen CI to catch regressions.
docs-bot: created issue https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/issues/812 with repro and CI link.
Nina: adding onboarding note recommending a relaxed mypy.ini in sampleapp and the defensive iteration pattern. Thanks.
